query: Herr Präsident! response_judge: Mr. President! response_reference: Mr President, despite the resources that have been deployed for years through the structural funds to promote territorial balance in the European Union, the per capita income of the 25 richest regions is still two and a half times higher than that of the poorest, and despite the many needs of these structurally weak regions, not all the resources allocated in the budget for development are used year after year.

response_judge: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European subsidies, having financially recovered, decide to lay off thousands of employees for reasons of structural adjustment and thereby bring their families into a state of emergency, only to then again draw on national and European public funds for their support.
response_reference: We cannot accept that companies which have benefited from European aid when they were financially healthy decide to lay off thousands of employees for reasons of structural adjustment, thereby putting their families in a precarious situation, for which national and European public funds are then claimed again to provide support.

query: Erstens: In dem Bericht Oomen-Ruijten wird völlig zu Recht die Forderung des Europäischen Parlaments nach Einführung einer Bewertung von Grenzauswirkungen erneuert, wonach die Mitgliedstaaten verpflichtet sind, bei Änderungen ihrer Rechtsvorschriften in den Bereichen soziale Sicherheit und Steuergesetzgebung die Auswirkungen für Grenzarbeitnehmer zu untersuchen, wobei den Grenzarbeitnehmern dadurch entstehende Nachteile ausgeglichen werden sollen, eine Regelung, die von einigen Mitgliedstaaten übrigens nur widerwillig angewandt wird.
response_judge: Firstly: The Oomen-Ruijten report entirely rightly reiterates the European Parliament's demand for the introduction of an assessment of border impact effects, according to which member states are obliged to investigate the effects for border workers in the event of changes to their legislation in the areas of social security and tax legislation, where the resulting disadvantages for border workers are to be offset, a regulation that is, incidentally, only reluctantly applied by some member states.
response_reference: Firstly: The Oomen-Ruijten report quite rightly reiterates the European Parliament's call for the introduction of an assessment of cross-border impacts, whereby Member States are required to examine the effects on cross-border workers when amending their legislation in the areas of social security and taxation, with a view to offsetting any disadvantages that may arise for cross-border workers, a provision that is, incidentally, applied only reluctantly by some Member States.

query: Um eine qualitativ hochstehende Schulbildung zu sichern, sind genügend Schulen, Klassen mit einer begrenzten Schülerzahl, eine ausreichende Zahl von Lehrkräften, Lehrer und technisches sowie Verwaltungspersonal auf allen Unterrichtsstufen, angefangen von der Grundschule, erforderlich, denn in allen Ländern Europas beginnt gerade in den Grundschulklassen ein Differenzierungsprozess, der sich für die Kinder der weniger begüterten Schichten in einem vielfach nicht wieder auszugleichenden Bildungsrückstand äußert.
response_judge: To ensure a high-quality education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teaching staff, teachers, and technical as well as administrative personnel are required at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins in elementary school classes, which manifests itself in a frequently irreparable educational backlog for the children of less affluent strata.
response_reference: To ensure a high-quality school education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teachers, instructors, and technical as well as administrative staff at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, are required, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins precisely in the elementary school classes, which for children from less affluent backgrounds often results in an educational disadvantage that cannot be compensated for in many cases.

response_judge: Therefore, we must preserve our architecture within this framework of defense, preservation, and promotion of our heritage, support our craftsmanship, care for and develop our landscapes, yet - and I would like to emphasize this - without cutting them off from life and without excluding the living traditions and cultural practices that reside within them.
